browser: Isolated headless Chromium 1243; no persistent browser profile
scope: Actual browser clicks, inputs, reload, clipboard and downloaded CSV against the local Next.js clone

checks.result: Done/todo mutually exclusive; favorite retained; details expose real source URL; note saves and survives reload; share copies local /tip/01-01 URL
One done/favorite counted; chapter 01 score 2/100; favorite/todo filters match state; downloaded CSV contains ID and saved note

Full-text search matches; unmatched query returns empty state; clearing search restores chapter grid; chapter 01 shows 43 entries; evidence A combines with chapter filter; exact very-high/high/standard tier labels and membership confirmed; multi-selection OR confirmed; disputed A-grade entries included; reset and original cost labels confirmed
Reading state shared with chapter; ignored action updates 2/50 progress; generated sharing URL reopens two selected items in a new page
BMI query returns one term and count; unmatched query shows empty state
Status marked in Chinese remains selected; translated details expand
Original value tier labels Very high / High / Standard confirmed in local filter menu

staticChecks: ESLint passed for reader-behaviors.ts and reader-data.ts
State checks passed for status merge, unmarking while retaining favorite, weighted progress calculation, and how-progress events
Extractor validates 677 unique entries in each of six languages

filterSourceVerification.method: Read-only public source page in an isolated browser; dropdown DOM inspected. Public route and localization scripts read as text only, never imported into the implementation.
filterSourceVerification.labels: All six languages' original filter text extracted into reader-data.ts as string data
filterSourceVerification.tiers: Large benefit + cost 0: very_high; large benefit + cost <=2 or medium benefit + cost 0: high; other known combinations: standard
filterSourceVerification.evidence: A/B/C filters use the leading grade, including entries whose grade includes a dispute or guideline qualifier
filterSourceVerification.combination: OR within a group; AND across groups, search and chapter

limits: Visual source/local comparison belongs to the main site validation
Top-50 sharing uses an encoded local query and preview, without the original site's remote share service
Full detail completeness depends on rerunning extract-tips.py after all source tip pages have downloaded
